factor_semantics.road: road network / routing conditions from selected year
factor_semantics.population: active population-demand surface from selected year
factor_semantics.hospital: hospital presence/location plus observed bed capacity from selected year

formal_method: exact Shapley; average marginal contribution over all 6 permutations
legacy_method: equal 1/4 weighting of four marginals plus proportional rescaling (audit only)

osm_topology_fallback.scope: pre-specified topology failures plus suspicious new-hospital x old-road counterfactual pairs
osm_topology_fallback.R_handling: R_j recomputed normally from scenario-specific D_j; no interpolation or cap

A000.legacy_label: base road + base pop + base hospital

A001.legacy_label: base road + base pop + target hospital

A010.legacy_label: base road + target pop + base hospital

A011.legacy_label: base road + target pop + target hospital

A100.legacy_label: target road + base pop + base hospital

A101.legacy_label: target road + base pop + target hospital

A110.legacy_label: target road + target pop + base hospital

A111.legacy_label: target road + target pop + target hospital
